items.description: Changes applied in order, at most 100.

cardId.description: The Card to change. Must be unique within the request (400 otherwise).

quantity.description: Absolute target quantity. 0 removes the Card.

maxCardCount.description: Hard cap on the Collection's summed card quantity; 0 means no limit.

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

code.description: A stable machine-readable code for the failure, set only when a client is meant to branch on it. login_required: this needs a signed-in caller.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

message.description: Human-readable reason for a declined item.

status.description: applied: set or created; removed: deleted, or already absent; declined: not applied.

score.description: How closely the photo matches this Card; candidates are ordered by it, highest first.

confident.description: True only when the server is sure of the first candidate. The server owns the threshold.
